_metadata.description: The resource-aware startup benchmark (axis ②) migrated greenfield from structure-health's perf domain.

requirements.title: Resource-aware startup measurement
requirements.description: startup restarts a scenario behind a runner seam and persists per-surface time-to-healthy plus a common.v1.ExecutionMetrics resource envelope to the trend store; reads are newest-first and scoped per scenario. Never invoked by a Test Genie phase.

validation.notes: Store round-trip, newest-first scoping, and a faked-runner benchmark persist with injected metrics.

requirements.title: Self-restart deadlock guard
requirements.description: The startup benchmark refuses to restart performance-health itself (self-restart deadlock guard) and surfaces runner errors rather than hanging.

validation.notes: Asserts the self-benchmark rejection and the runner-error propagation path.
